name: Shikkoku no Hana
source:
England in the late 19th century. An estate is lost in the gamble. Main character is the winner's son who is given this estate as a present. All the things and people of the mansion become protagonist's possessions. Protagonist enters this mansion as a butler and starts to spread his poison.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
19世纪末的英国。一座庄园在赌博中易主。主人公是赢家的儿子，这座庄园被当作礼物送给他。宅邸的一切与所有人都成了主人公的财产。他以管家的身份进入宅邸，开始散播自己的毒害。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
